pokedexEntries.rb: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

pokedexEntries.ye: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.

pokedexEntries.go: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

pokedexEntries.si: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

pokedexEntries.cr: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

pokedexEntries.rs: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this POKéMON does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.

pokedexEntries.fr: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.lg: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.

pokedexEntries.em: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.

pokedexEntries.di: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

pokedexEntries.prl: It squirms through the ground using its long and rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.

pokedexEntries.pt: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
